ui.helpWallpaperQ: DiyarDesk keeps flickering or restarting. How do I fix it?
ui.helpWallpaperA: If your regular desktop wallpaper changes automatically, each change can make DiyarDesk flicker or restart. Use a fixed background that does not rotate.
ui.helpWallpaperStep2: Set ‘Personalize your background’ to ‘Picture’ or ‘Solid color’. Do not use ‘Slideshow’ or ‘Windows spotlight’.
ui.helpWallpaperStep3: Restart DiyarDesk after changing this setting.

ui.importThemeTitle: Import a theme package (.zip, .deskland), HTML page, image, or video
ui.importHelpSubtitle: Click + Import theme… to pick a local file. All of the following formats are supported and validated automatically:
ui.importHelpZipDesc: Multi-file HTML/JS/CSS Web themes, native OpenGL 3.3 GLSL shader packages (manifest.json + main.frag), and security-approved Rust + OpenGL cdylib plugins (Cargo.toml + src/lib.rs). Engine type is detected automatically with seamless UI switching; zip-slip paths and symlinks are blocked.
ui.importHelpHtmlDesc: Single-file interactive shader or HTML themes (uses the <title> tag as the theme name).
ui.importHelpImageDesc: Automatically wrapped into an interactive wallpaper page with gentle ambient zoom/pan, brightness, motion, and icon backdrop halo (dimIcons) controls, adaptive layout, and snapshot sharing (desklandSnapshot).
ui.importHelpVideoDesc: Plays looped video cleanly with brightness, playback speed, and icon backdrop halo (dimIcons) controls.
ui.importHelpNote: Archives are verified for integrity before unpacking (max 150 MB / 2,000 files per package). Imported themes are stored in your user folder and can be deleted anytime using Remove in the preview header.
ui.importHelpManifestMetaDesc: Supports name/title, desc/description, entry/page/main/file (defaults to index.html), adaptive (true/false), and thumb/thumbnail/preview (relative image path including .svg, or CSS color/gradient).
ui.importHelpManifestParamsDesc: Accepts both DiyarDesk's native groups array ([{ name, params }]) and grouped settings objects (using group/category); supports sliders (range: min/max/step/default), selectors (select: string lists or { label, value } options), and toggles (checkbox: true/false).
ui.importHelpProtoReadyDesc: Call window.chrome.webview.postMessage('ready') in wallpaper mode, or parent.postMessage(JSON.stringify({ t: 'ready' }), '*') in preview mode (?preview=1) to receive initial settings and icon rectangles.
ui.importHelpProtoMsgDesc: Your page receives { t: 'icons', vis, r: [[l, t, r, b], ...] } (physical pixels; divide by devicePixelRatio for CSS pixels), { t: 'settings', v: {...} }, { t: 'reset', v: {...} }, and { t: 'pause', v: true|false }. Optionally expose window.desklandSnapshot() / window.desklandRecord() for sharing.
ui.lowModeTitle: Strict eco optimization: 15 FPS limit, 0.75x scale, disables heavy blurs/shadows and pauses faster behind windows
ui.disableAutoPauseTitle: When enabled, animations keep playing even when a maximized or fullscreen window is open
ui.solarSyncTitle: Subtly adapt wallpaper tone across local dawn, day, dusk, and night (100% offline)
ui.windowAwareTitle: Let adaptive scenes react to open windows on iconless Wayland compositors (Hyprland/Sway/niri) and desktop
ui.systemBridgeTitle: Opt-in local CPU/RAM/battery & audio spectrum bridge for reactive themes (100% offline)
ui.preferMpvTitle: Use hardware-accelerated mpv for imported video wallpapers when installed
ui.syncLockscreenTitle: Save a blurred lock screen image from the active wallpaper
ui.rustOpenGlBannerDesc: Shuts down all WebView2 processes and runs natively on Rust OpenGL 3.3 — uses up to 900 MB less RAM with smoother performance.
ui.rustOpenGlTitle: Fast & lightweight: runs all built-in themes and settings on the native Rust OpenGL 3.3 Core engine with zero WebView2 processes, saving up to 900 MB RAM (switch off anytime to return to WebView2)
ui.rustOpenGlHint: This theme runs on the native engine, so WebView2 is not needed and may still hold ~{mb} MB in the background. Click below to release it.

Includes scalloped Cookie hybrid clock, live wavy music player, offline DiyarDesk Calendar (.ics import), DiyarDesk Tasks, /todo command & calculator bar, notes, and Pomodoro + system rings.
